name: Default
shortDescription: Sub-second latency live streaming server that ingests RTMP, SRT, WebRTC and RTSP sources and delivers them over Low-Latency HLS, HLS and WebRTC, with a REST API.

alerts.message: Only HTTP is routed: play a stream at https://<your domain>/app/<stream>/llhls.m3u8 (LL-HLS) or /app/<stream>/ts:playlist.m3u8 (HLS). The domain root has no page of its own. WebRTC signaling answers at wss://<your domain>/app/<stream>, but WebRTC media also needs the ICE ports below. Without published ingest ports, create streams by pulling an RTSP or OVT source with POST https://<your domain>/v1/vhosts/default/apps/app/streams, using the OME_API_ACCESS_TOKEN value as Basic auth user:password. Pulled streams are not kept across restarts.

To push from OBS or an encoder, add ports to the ovenmediaengine service in the app's Compose file (this needs the Publish ports permission) and redeploy: 1935/tcp for RTMP (rtmp://<server IP>:1935/app/<stream>), 9999/udp for SRT, and 3478/tcp, 10000/tcp and 10000-10003/udp for WebRTC publishing and playback, which also needs OME_HOST_IP set to the server's public IP. Anyone who can reach these ports can publish unless you configure SignedPolicy or Admission Webhooks in Server.xml.
